events.name: CacheEntry loaded
events.description: Indicates a cache entry has been successfully retrieved.

events.name: CacheEntry load failed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load a cache entry.

events.name: Cached
events.description: Data retrieved successfully from the cache.

events.name: CacheEntry updated
events.description: Signals that a cached entry's data has been modified.

events.name: CacheEntry update failed
events.description: Indicates a failure to update a cached entry.

staleWhileRevalidate.label: Serve stale while revalidating
staleWhileRevalidate.description: When true, serve stale entries to consumers while a background refresh fetches fresh data. Reduces latency at the cost of brief staleness.

maxCacheSize.label: Max cache entries
maxCacheSize.description: Hard cap on cached entries before eviction. 0 = unlimited.

emptyLook.label: Empty-state look
emptyLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the empty-state placeholder.

tableLook.label: Table look
tableLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the data table rendered by this atom.

ttlSeconds.label: TTL (seconds)
ttlSeconds.description: Cache entry time-to-live before it goes stale. Default 5 minutes. Shorter = fresher/real-time data; longer = stable/long-lived caching.
ttlSeconds.synonyms: expiration, time to live, cache duration, freshness, real-time (short) vs long-lived (long)

evictionPolicy.label: Eviction policy
evictionPolicy.description: How entries are evicted when the cache fills: least-recently-used, least-frequently-used, first-in-first-out, or TTL-only (never evict early).

name.description: Icon name as string (resolved from iconMap)

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Lucide icon component (preferred for type-safe usage), OR a canonical kebab-case icon name string — a string is treated exactly like `name` so trait/factory authors can pass an icon by name through the `icon` prop.

strokeWidth.label: Stroke Width
strokeWidth.description: Icon stroke width - uses theme default if not specified

color.label: Color
color.description: Semantic palette token or an arbitrary Tailwind color class.

format.label: Format
format.description: Value formatting applied to string/number/Date content — `none` (the default) renders content as-is. Covers the raw-ISO-date class: a bound datetime renders human-readable via `format='date'|'time'|'datetime'`.

level.label: Level
level.description: Heading level (1-6) - alternative to variant for headings

weight.label: Weight
weight.description: Font weight override — `none` = no override, the variant's baked weight applies
